g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to find the process causing a slow PC using Task
Manager: the order for reading three tabs
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-29
Check the overall load in the
Performance tab
The Performance tab displays the computer’s
overall CPU and memory usage in graphs.
Find high-usage items in the Processes
tab
The Processes tab lists apps and background
processes, along with each item’s CPU and memory
usage.
Check the description and user in the
Details tab
The Details tab lists running processes and
provides additional columns such as user
information, resource usage, and Description.
Four steps to check before ending a
process

can stop a process or turn off a related
